Working with **film-crew → seedance-25-director**.

Before I started: this workspace isn't a git checkout, so I couldn't run `git pull`, and there is no `NOTES.md` to check for open items. I didn't change any files, so there's no NOTES entry or push either.

**My assumptions:**
- No reference uploads, so every prompt is text-only.
- Overlay text is in English (I can add Armenian or Russian versions).
- Music goes on in the edit.
- The logo is **never generated**. The brand guide says to always use the real logo file and never redraw it, so shot 6 is built in the edit from `maghakian_logo_light.png`.

## Crew plan (short)

- **Director:** the story is "from the first line on a page to the screen", which matches what the studio sells: scripts and turnkey production. Every shot is one step of that path. Red appears only twice: the camera's record light (when the story becomes real) and the triangle in the logo.
- **Look:** a precise, low-key style. The camera is locked off or moves slowly. There is one hard key light, the edges fall to black, and the picture is black and white except for that one red.
- **Shot count:** 30 s at about 5 s per shot gives 6 shots. Five are generated in Seedance and one (the end card) is built in the edit.
- **Design:** graphite table #111111, white paper, black ink, a dark soundstage, a dark screening room. There are no readable words anywhere in the generated frames.
- **Costume:** the actress in shot 4 wears a plain black wool coat and her dark hair is pulled back. No logos.
- **Sound:** each shot keeps its natural sounds (pen nib, paper, camera click, clapper, projector). A low pulse track goes on in the edit, with a hit on every cut. The generations have no music and no subtitles.

| # | Cut time | Shot | Size / lens / move | Overlay (added in edit) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0–5 s | Pen writes on a blank page | Macro close-up, 100mm, slides right with the nib | "Every story starts on a page." |
| 2 | 5–10 s | Towers of scripts on the writers' table | Top-down wide, 35mm, slow descent | "2,300+ episodes written" |
| 3 | 10–14 s | Cinema camera, red record light comes on | Low-angle medium shot, 35mm, slow dolly-in | "48 projects" |
| 4 | 14–19.5 s | Clapper snaps and reveals the actress | Close-up to medium close-up, 50mm, locked off | "Script. Production. Screen." |
| 5 | 19.5–24 s | Screening room, push into the white screen | Wide, 24mm, slow push-in to full white | "Turnkey, from first page to final cut." |
| 6 | 24–30 s | End card: logo on black | Built in the edit | Logo plus "maghakianscripts.com" |

**How each cut works:**
- **1→2:** the white paper fills the frame, then cuts to white paper seen from above (a graphic match from close-up to wide). The sound of a sheet landing bridges the cut.
- **2→3:** a hard cut from bright to dark, with a hit in the music.
- **3→4:** the red record light holds and the clapper's crack lands right on the cut, going from a medium shot to a close-up.
- **4→5:** the actress looks toward frame-right, and the screen in shot 5 sits frame-right, so the look carries across the cut. The projector whir starts under the end of shot 4.
- **5→6:** the shot goes to full white, flashes for 2 frames, then cuts to black and the logo appears.

**Generation:** each shot is a separate Omni Reference call, generated 1 s longer than it plays so you can trim the start. The shots are in different places and share no characters, so hard cuts between separate calls are more reliable than one 25 s call that moves through five locations.

**Real risks:**
- Seedance may add a little colour to the black-and-white image. Fix it with a colour-isolation grade in the edit (keep only the red).
- Hands in shot 1 can warp, so check the fingers and regenerate if needed.
- The clapper may show gibberish text. The prompt asks for a blank slate.
- I have not generated any of this; these risks are expected, not tested.

## FINAL

**Settings for all 5 calls:** Dreamina → Seedance 2.5 → **Omni Reference**, ratio **9:16**, **720p** (1080p if your account has it), no uploads. Durations: S1 6 s · S2 6 s · S3 5 s · S4 6 s · S5 5 s. In the edit, trim each to the cut times in the table above.

**S1: The page (generate 6 s)**
```text
One-line summary: extreme macro close-up of a fountain pen writing fast handwriting on a blank white sheet of paper on a dark graphite desk, black-and-white monochrome, single hard desk-lamp key light from frame-left, cinematic and tactile.

[0-3s] Macro 100mm lens, very shallow depth of field. The steel nib of a black fountain pen touches the white paper and draws a fast line of loose handwriting in glossy wet black ink; the camera slides slowly to the right at the same speed as the nib, keeping the nib just left of centre. Paper fibres and the wet shine of the ink are sharp; the background falls into black. Sound: the dry scratch of the nib on paper, soft paper rustle.
[3-6s] The nib finishes the line, lifts off the paper and exits the top of the frame; the camera stops and holds on the fresh wet ink line drying on bright white paper, which now fills most of the frame. Sound: the scratch stops, quiet room tone.
➖ No readable words or letters, the handwriting is illegible loose strokes; no second hand; no colour.

Global: black-and-white monochrome image, deep blacks, bright clean whites, fine film grain, one hard key light from frame-left, controlled precise camera, natural writing speed. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no background music, no logos, no watermark.
```

**S2: The room (generate 6 s)**
```text
One-line summary: top-down overhead shot of a long dark graphite writers' table covered with hundreds of printed screenplays stacked in tall towers, a single hanging lamp lighting the centre, black-and-white monochrome, precise slow descent.

[0-3s] Straight top-down view, 35mm lens. A long matte graphite table fills the vertical frame; dozens of towers of white bound screenplays and black binders stand in neat rows, some stacks waist-high; a single overhead lamp makes one bright pool of light at the centre, the table edges falling into black. The camera descends slowly and steadily straight down. Sound: low room tone, faint lamp hum.
[3-6s] A man's hand in a black sleeve enters from frame-bottom and places one more white bound screenplay flat on top of the centre stack, squares its edges with two fingers, then withdraws out of frame; the camera finishes its descent and holds still on the centre stack. Sound: the soft heavy thud of the script landing, a short paper slide.
➖ No faces, no readable text on the covers or pages, no clutter beyond scripts and binders, no colour.

Global: black-and-white monochrome image, deep blacks, bright paper whites, graphite surfaces, fine film grain, single overhead pool of light, symmetrical composition, controlled camera. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no background music, no logos, no watermark.
```

**S3: The set (generate 5 s)**
```text
One-line summary: dark film soundstage, a professional cinema camera on a dolly, its small red recording light switches on, black-and-white monochrome image where the only colour is that deep crimson red light, slow precise dolly-in.

[0-2.5s] Low angle, 35mm lens. A black professional cinema camera with a matte box sits on a dolly in a dark soundstage; one hard rim light from behind frame-left outlines the camera body, light haze in the air, the background is black with faint outlines of light stands. The camera slowly dollies in toward the cinema camera's side panel. Sound: soundstage hum, faint dolly wheels.
[2.5-5s] A gloved operator's finger presses the record button on the side of the camera; a small deep crimson red recording light turns on and glows steadily in the frame centre-right; the dolly-in eases to a stop and holds on the red light and the camera body. Sound: a crisp mechanical button click, a faint motor whir starting.
➖ The red light is the only colour in the frame; no other red objects; no faces; no readable brand names or text on the camera; no lens flares in colour.

Global: black-and-white monochrome image except the single deep crimson red recording light, deep blacks, haze, fine film grain, one hard rim light from frame-left, slow controlled dolly. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no background music, no logos, no watermark.
```

**S4: Action (generate 6 s)**
```text
One-line summary: a black-and-white film clapperboard snaps shut right in front of the lens and drops away to reveal an actress in a single hard key light, black-and-white monochrome, locked-off camera.

[0-2s] Locked-off camera, 50mm lens. A blank black-and-white clapperboard with plain diagonal stripes on the clapstick and a clean empty slate fills the lower half of the frame, held by a hand; the clapstick snaps shut. Sound: one sharp wooden clap crack.
[2-6s] The clapperboard drops quickly out of the bottom of the frame, revealing a woman in her early 30s in medium close-up, dark hair pulled back tight, plain black wool coat, standing against a black background; one hard key light from frame-left lights half her face, the other half in shadow. She is still for a beat, takes one slow breath through the nose, then lifts her eyes from the floor to a point just off-lens to frame-right and holds them there, jaw set, without smiling. Sound: after the clap, near silence, her single breath, distant soundstage hum.
➖ No readable writing on the slate; no smiling, no talking, no tears; no extra people; no colour.

Global: black-and-white monochrome image, deep blacks, hard single key from frame-left, realistic skin with real fine pores and skin texture, fine film grain, locked-off camera, restrained performance. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no background music, no logos, no watermark.
```

**S5: The screen (generate 5 s)**
```text
One-line summary: a dark empty screening room, a projector beam cutting through haze onto a large glowing white screen on frame-right, the camera pushes slowly forward until white light fills the whole frame, black-and-white monochrome.

[0-3s] Wide shot, 24mm lens, camera low between the backs of rows of dark empty cinema seats. A bright projector beam cuts diagonally through light haze from behind the camera toward a large blank white screen set slightly to frame-right; the room is black except the beam and the screen glow on the seat edges. The camera pushes slowly and steadily forward between the seats. Sound: steady whir of a film projector, low room tone.
[3-5s] The push continues and the bright white screen grows until it fills the entire frame with pure even white; hold on full white. Sound: projector whir swells slightly, then holds.
➖ No image or text on the screen, the screen stays blank white; no people; no colour.

Global: black-and-white monochrome image, deep blacks, glowing whites, visible haze in the beam, fine film grain, one slow continuous push-in. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no background music, no logos, no watermark.
```

**S6: End card (built in the edit, not generated): 24–30 s**
- **Background:** solid #000000 with light grain. Cut in from S5's white with a 2-frame white flash.
- **24.3–26.0 s:** reveal `maghakian_logo_light.png` (white ink) at the centre with a left-to-right write-on mask. Use the real file only, without stretching, recolouring or redrawing it.
- **26.0 s:** the red #D90429 triangle (the dot of the "i") lands last, with one soft low hit in the music.
- **26.5–30 s:** hold the full wordmark. "maghakianscripts.com" fades in small beneath it in white sans-serif.

**Overlays (S1–S5):** white sans-serif, lower third, inside the Reels safe zone (clear of the bottom 20% and the right-side icons). Each appears 0.3 s after its cut and leaves 0.3 s before the next one:
